d: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.
Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

Dogs are not only man's best friend, they can also serve as therapists. “Cute Pet Guide” help you train your dog to become a therapy dog. Aside from canned dog food, owners can be more attentive and prepare sumptuous meals for their pets through chef video tutorials. “Cute Pet Guide” will present you and your furry babies with exquisite dishes of love!

Dr. Matt rushes off to answer an urgent call from Flamingoland, where a pregnant rare pygmy goat may need an emergency caesarean. Eight abandoned baby rabbits need some very close attention while back at the zoo there's been trouble at the lemur house. A fight has left one female with a nasty wound but she'd reluctant to receive treatment.

Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond

At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks.  Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue.  She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

Dr. Matt helps to save a badger knocked down by car but will it return to the wild? He relieves a cat with a particular problem and helps a farmer catch a runaway calf. Up at the Zoo he knocks out a polar bear and puts a Zebra back on her feet.

In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner.  The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate.  Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?
